nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $r$, $n$ has at most $r$ distinct prime factors when $n = 0$ or at most $r$ distinct primes divide $n$; the number $0$ is counted as having no prime factors.
nodes.title: Natural numbers with at most $r$ distinct prime factors

nodes.summary: A natural number $m$ is of this form when $m = 2^k + p$ for some natural number $k$ and some prime $p$.
nodes.title: Sums of a power of two and a prime

nodes.summary: For a natural number $r$, a natural number $m$ is of this form when $m = 2^k + n$ for some natural numbers $k$ and $n$ such that $n = 0$ or at most $r$ distinct primes divide $n$.
nodes.title: Sums of a power of two and a number with few prime factors

nodes.summary: The set of natural numbers of the form $2^k + p$, with $k$ a natural number and $p$ prime, has positive lower density. Moreover, for every real number $\varepsilon > 0$ there is a natural number $r$ such that the set of natural numbers of the form $2^k + n$, with $k$ and $n$ natural numbers and with $n = 0$ or at most $r$ distinct primes dividing $n$, has lower density at least $1 - \varepsilon$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 851 is true
